headline: FBI Adds TraderTraitor Detail to Binance Theft Attribution
deck: The FBI’s North Korea attribution and Binance’s replacement statement ran on 1 November; this report adds the agency’s description of the group’s alleged conversion of assets into Ether.
body: The Federal Bureau of Investigation said North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6bn in virtual assets from Binance on or about 29 October. The paper reported that attribution on 1 November. [E1]

This edition adds the FBI’s description of the activity: it labeled the actors TraderTraitor and said it had observed them converting stolen tokens to Ether while preparing further laundering. The paper’s 1 November Binance replacement-ledger carried the company’s separate replacement statement. [E4]
Al Jazeera reported that the agency also blamed TraderTraitor for a $1.5bn theft from the Bybit platform in February last year. [E2]
Binance said it had replaced 90% of the amount stolen by using company money to buy new tokens. [E3]
